tools.name: diamond_catalog
tools.description: Free. Lists Diamond's paid Bitcoin intelligence tools with prices in sats and USD, payment methods (x402 USDC on Base, Lightning) and terms.

tools.name: bitcoin_sanctions_screen
tools.description: Free. Is this Bitcoin address on the OFAC SDN sanctions list or a known ransomware payment address? Exact list matches only. For ownership clusters, sweeper bots and laundering patterns use bitcoin_address_risk.

tools.name: bitcoin_address_risk
tools.description: Screens one Bitcoin address: OFAC sanctions, ransomware payment lists, ownership clusters, sweeper bots and laundering-pattern cases seen by this node. Price: 300 sats or US$0.25 (USDC) per call.

tools.name: bitcoin_market_pulse
tools.description: Live: fee rates (1 block to 1 day), mempool, last 24 h whale transactions and AML cases from this node, implied BTC/USD. Price: 20 sats or US$0.02 (USDC) per call.

tools.name: whale_geopolitics_report
tools.description: One day's report: whale flows vs world news, lagged correlations, laundering patterns, headlines and the analyst brief (JSON). Price: 1000 sats or US$0.8 (USDC) per call.

tools.name: watch_bitcoin_address
tools.description: Alerts for 30 days on every confirmed transaction paying to or spending from the address: private feed (web, JSON, RSS) and phone push. Returns the feed links. Price: 1000 sats or US$1 (USDC) per call.

tools.name: bitcoin_batch_risk
tools.description: Screens up to 25 Bitcoin addresses in one call: OFAC sanctions, ransomware payment lists, ownership clusters, sweeper bots and laundering-pattern cases for each, plus a summary of the flagged ones. For counterparty and withdrawal-address due diligence; about 60% cheaper per address than single check

tools.name: search
tools.description: Free. Search Diamond's available tools, use cases, input descriptions and published prices.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Analyze one to 25 buyer-supplied transaction sizes against a per-transaction fee cap. plan=budget_sats:vbytes[,vbytes...], e.g. 1000:140,220,350. Uses fresh node fee estimates, rounds up to whole sats, and returns the fastest observed estimate fitting each cap. Estimates do not guarantee confirmatio

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Generate a verified Bitcoin Core Merkle inclusion receipt for one to five transactions in one retained block. locator=blockhash:txid[,txid...]. Verify against a trusted header chain. Does not establish unspentness or irreversible finality. Price: 20 sats or US$0.02 (USDC) per call.

tools.name: score
tools.description: Return Diamond's existing heuristic risk level and findings for one Bitcoin address. Combines public list matches and node observations. Flags require review; a clean result does not certify safety, legal compliance or ownership. Price: 300 sats or US$0.25 (USDC) per call.

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Free. Choose a Diamond tool for fees, inclusion, outputs, CPFP, risk, monitoring, daily reports or market data. Compares the published per-call price with an optional budget. Creates no payment.

tools.name: check_outputs
tools.description: Batch output status for one to 25 unique Bitcoin outpoints (txid:vout pairs). Reports this node's chainstate and sequential mempool observations, value, script, confirmations and coinbase flag. Missing does not prove spent. tools.name: bitcoin_fee_estimates
tools.description: Bitcoin fee estimates right now: sat/vB to confirm within 1, 2, 3, 6, 12, 24, 144, 504 and 1008 blocks (Bitcoin Core estimatesmartfee on this node), plus mempool size and minimum relay fee. Paid per call. Price: 3 sats or US$0.003 (USDC) per call.

tools.name: bitcoin_latest_block
tools.description: The latest Bitcoin block: height, hash, age, transaction count, total fees, fee-rate percentiles, size, weight and subsidy. Paid per call. Price: 3 sats or US$0.003 (USDC) per call.

tools.description: Decode a raw Bitcoin transaction (hex): txid, wtxid, size, vsize, weight, inputs, outputs with addresses and values, SegWit and RBF flags. Nothing is broadcast. Paid per call. Price: 3 sats or US$0.003 (USDC) per call.

tools.description: Validate and classify one Bitcoin address: valid or not (with the reason), type (P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH, P2WSH, P2TR), witness version and scriptPubKey. Paid per call. Price: 2 sats or US$0.002 (USDC) per call.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: score, bitcoin_transaction_aml_check · Private data: watch_bitcoin_address · Public sink: analyze, plan_cpfp, bitcoin_decode_transaction, bitcoin_decode_psbt, bitcoin_block_stats, bitcoin_mining_pools, bitcoin_aml_live, bitcoin_transaction_aml_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: score, bitcoin_transaction_aml_check · Private data: watch_bitcoin_address · Public sink: analyze, plan_cpfp, bitcoin_decode_transaction, bitcoin_decode_psbt, bitcoin_block_stats, bitcoin_mining_pools, bitcoin_aml_live, bitcoin_transaction_aml_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
